subject: reasoning
question: Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. Only four boxes are kept between F and A. Only B is kept above F. Only two boxes are kept between G and E. D is kept immediately above C. E is not kept immediately above D. How many boxes are kept between E and F?
solution:
Seven boxes A, B, C, D, E, F and G are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• Only four boxes are kept between F and A.
 
• Only B is kept above F.
 
• Only two boxes are kept between G and E.
 
• D is kept immediately above C.
 
• E is not kept immediately above D

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
B

 
 
 

 
 
F

 
 
 

 
 
G

 
 
 

 
 
D

 
 
 

 
 
C

 
 
 

 
 
E

 
 
 

 
 
A

 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**
